correctness.rationale: Scalar fields p+(q-p-r)x-qx^2 point inward at 0 and 1. Each time-T Riccati flow is a positive-denominator fractional linear map induced by exp(TL), with off-diagonal positive and diagonal positive because sigma>|beta|. The two projective compositions have quadratic numerator N and everywhere-positive denominator, proving at most two sign changes for arbitrary strictly positive model parameters. Independently multiplied exact positive matrices A=(40,12;14,62), B=(34,4;30,32), recovering N=128(3697x^2-3962x+493). Exact signs at x=0,1/2,1 are +,-,+; two simple roots lie in (0,1), attained for p1=6,q1=7,r1=12,T1=log2/17 and p2=2,q2=15,r2=12,T2=log2/11. Continuity retains two roots under small common-attrition perturbation. A common equilibrium e is fixed by both maps; equal composition derivatives force N(e)=N_prime(e)=0; degree<=2 implies constant sign. The attrition-free Bass boundary e=1 follows though not assumed in positive-attrition theorem.
